brief: A caddy to carry my bottle of bleach and a scrub brush around the house.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full is a full-depth hex bin (~143x125mm floor, 77mm deep); no bleach-bottle prop exists in find_props so fit could not be staged. Typical bleach jug likely taller/wider than this single cell.
bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain (drained full-depth bin for wet tools) plus prop:1 paint brush stood upright in bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full as a stand-in; no scrub-brush prop exists in the catalog.
handle:1,0,0;top on cover:1,0,0;full;top in middle cell of 3-cell row; check_build ok, meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Carry around the house (portable caddy with handle)

requirements.evidence: Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; configurator checks fit/collisions only, not chemical resistance, strength, or spill containment. Bleach compatibility is unmet.
requirements.requirement: Safe/compatible with bleach (chemical resistance, spill handling)

finish.summary: 3-cell caddy: two full-depth bins (one drained) on the ends and a handled cover in the middle for carrying. Brush staged standing in a bin; no bleach-bottle or scrub-brush props exist so exact fit could not be proven, and bleach chemical safety cannot be verified in this system.

- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
